from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.vector_search import get_retrieval_pipeline

class Hou_Mcp_Asset_Retrieval(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_asset_retrieval"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("action",      "string", widget_type="text", default="retrieve")
        self.add_input("intent",      "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("environment", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("role",        "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("story_role",  "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_input("top_k",       "int",    widget_type="int", default=10)
        self.add_input("use_vector",  "bool",   widget_type="checkbox", default=True)
        self.add_output("assets",        "list")
        self.add_output("total",         "int")
        self.add_output("parsed_intent", "any")
        self.add_output("strategy",      "string")
        self.add_output("result",        "any")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        action     = str(inputs.get("action") or "retrieve").strip().lower()
        intent     = str(inputs.get("intent") or "").strip()
        environment= str(inputs.get("environment") or "").strip()
        role       = str(inputs.get("role") or "").strip()
        story_role = str(inputs.get("story_role") or "").strip()
        top_k      = int(inputs.get("top_k") or 10)
        use_vector = bool(inputs.get("use_vector", True))
        try:
            pipeline = get_retrieval_pipeline()
            if action == "retrieve_environment":
                result = pipeline.retrieve_environment_assets(environment, role=role, top_k=top_k)
            elif action == "retrieve_hero":
                result = pipeline.retrieve_hero_assets(environment=environment, top_k=top_k)
            elif action == "retrieve_storytelling":
                result = pipeline.retrieve_storytelling_assets(story_role, environment=environment, top_k=top_k)
            else:
                result = pipeline.retrieve(intent or environment or story_role, top_k=top_k, use_vector_search=use_vector)
            return {
                "assets":        result.assets,
                "total":         result.total,
                "parsed_intent": result.parsed_intent,
                "strategy":      result.strategy,
                "result":        result.to_dict(),
                "exec_out":      True,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_asset_retrieval failed: {e}")
            return {"assets": [], "total": 0, "parsed_intent": {}, "strategy": "", "result": {}, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Asset_Retrieval
